title: Optional Unleashed flips for the ATV
summary: Extras → Flips adds the MX vs. ATV Unleashed backflip and left/right three-sixty to the ATVs. It is off by default, so the original ATV2 ride is unchanged.
details: Unleashed's ATV stunt list has a Backflip and Three Sixty Left/Right as special tricks; all eight Unleashed ATV physics files use the same flip tuning as the bikes. There is no front flip in Unleashed, so none was added.
Controls: hold L1 (keyboard L) alone and pull back (E) for a backflip, or flick sideways (A/D) for a 360, either on the ramp lip or just after takeoff.
Spin torques are scaled by ATV2's air damping so the ATV turns at Unleashed's rate, about 2–3 rad/s.
ATV2's in-air ejection angles are skipped only while a flip is active; landings still use the original ground and impact checks. A clean landing shows the trick name and 2000 points per rotation.
The follow camera now holds the takeoff heading mid-flip instead of swinging into the ground.
limitation: The rider keeps the ATV2 air pose (no Unleashed flip animation yet). There are no touch controls for flips, CPU riders don't flip, and flip points are display-only.
caption: Mid-backflip on env01 with Flips on: the ATV is upside down past ATV2's 85° ejection angle and the HUD shows Backflip.
